# Documentation templates

Use the closest template when adding a maintained Markdown document. Copy it, replace the guidance with project-specific content, and remove any section that does not apply.

- [Reference or schema](reference.md)
- [Research note](research-note.md)
- [Experiment or example](experiment.md)
- [Tool or component guide](tool-guide.md)

A template is not evidence. Technical claims still require an observation, a reproducible example, or an explicit confidence label.
